coverage_limits.description: Native Windows environments without Developer Mode or elevated privileges raise WinError 1314 (ERROR_PRIVILEGE_NOT_HELD) upon creating file or directory symlinks. Tests in test_preview_symlink_safety.py and test_windows_portability.py (such as test_render_html_rejects_symlinked_output_escaping_directory, test_render_html_still_follows_symlink_within_same_directory, test_render_html_accepts_symlink_into_a_subdirectory, test_render_live_html_rejects_symlinked_output_escaping_directory, test_open_safe_output_refuses_a_symlink_planted_after_the_check, and test_session_current_directory_symlink) skip gracefully via tests._symlinks.symlink_to. These skipped tests represent coverage gaps on unprivileged Windows systems.

Native Windows lacks POSIX directory file descriptor support (neither os.O_NOFOLLOW combined with os.O_DIRECTORY nor dir_fd in os.open are supported, setting _SUPPORTS_DIR_FD to False). Consequently, test_open_safe_output_leaf_creation_is_pinned_to_the_opened_directory cannot execute on native Windows and is skipped, leaving directory descriptor-pinned leaf creation untested on Win32.
